Instaread

Get ready for an unforgettable evening celebrating the timeless music and legacy of Stevie Wonder!

Join Host and Poet Queen and Ivan Orr & Friends for a soulful journey through the songs that have touched generations—from love and joy to hope and inspiration.

Proceeds will benefit the Music Resource Center as well as the Jefferson School African American Heritage Center.

African-Americans

  • Date: Sunday, September 27
  • Time: Showtime at 7 PM (Doors open at 6:30 PM)
  • Location: Jefferson School African American Heritage Center Auditorium
  • Address: 233 4th St NW, Charlottesville, VA

Come sing, feel, and celebrate 50 years of Songs in the Key of Life!

With Love & Gratitude,

  • Black Professional Network of Charlottesville
  • NadiTings Customs
  • Ivan Orr
  • Queen India Nixon
  • Music Resource Center
  • Jefferson School African American Heritage Center
